state.request:
Add BB Tasks (the official bb 'tasks' plugin) as a fifth tracker source 'bbtasks' in the taskboard plugin, at full parity with GitHub/GitLab/Linear/Jira.

Scope (approved plan: plans/2026-10-06_21-07_bb-tasks-taskboard-source.md):
1. contract.ts: 'bbtasks' in workSourceSchema; bbTasksProjectId in projectSourceConfigSchema; bbTasksProjects list in projectConfigViewSchema; 'Tasks project' in destinationLabel enum; sourceName() -> 'BB Tasks'.
2. New sources/bb-tasks.ts adapter implementing WorkSourceAdapter via bb.sdk.plugins.callRpc(pluginId:'tasks', ...) with locally re-declared zod schemas (listProjects with linkedBbProjectId, listTasks pagination, getTaskByKey, listComments, listLabels, createTask, updateTask); locator = task key; 6 fixed statuses mapped to workStateCategory (in_review -> in_progress); createIssueMetadata from fixed statuses/priorities + project labels; create via createTask; updateStatus via updateTask {authorName:'Taskboard'}; graceful configurationMessage when tasks plugin is missing.
3. store.ts SQLite migration widening CHECK source enums on work_items_by_project/source_sync_by_project/project_source_config + bb_tasks_project_id column; config mapping updates.
4. server.ts: SOURCES += 'bbtasks'; DEFAULT_PROJECT_CONFIG; adapters() branch; getCreateIssueContext destinations 'Tasks project' (linked tasks project default); changedSources/sameProjectConfig; CLI usage strings + --bb-tasks-project.
5. app.tsx: SOURCE_FILTER_OPTIONS, TRACKER_OPTIONS, isWorkSource, sourceName, SourceGlyph, Manage tasks-project picker, hide Open button on empty url.
6. Tests: contract.test.ts additions; new test/sources-bb-tasks.test.ts with fake callRpc.
7. README sections + keywords + version 0.3.3 -> 0.4.0.

User decisions: source id 'bbtasks'; full write parity (issue creation + status moves); hide Open button when url is empty; updateStatus uses updateTask (not boardMove).
